name: SafetyCriticalElementAssurance
tagline: Keep every major-accident barrier assured – SCE register, assurance tests, impairments and ORAs in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete barrier-management module for oil & gas facilities: performance standards and criteria per safety-critical element, assurance task schedule and results, automatic impairment on failed tests, operational risk assessments with residual risk, independent approval and expiry limits, restoration tests before return to service, barrier health by SCE group and facility, and an impairment & ORA report for the daily operations call. Drop it on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page and it works immediately with demo data.
features: 11 quick filters, grouping, bulk test results and assignment
ORA approval with residual 5×5 risk, independent approver and duration limits
Restoration test required before return to service
Impairment & ORA report and CSV export
Undo, keyboard and touch operation, phone layout
